motivation: The step-matched post hoc disease-only check changed the setting of PSAN (c1 to c2) and the training length (30 to 72 epochs) together. These runs complete the 2 x 2 design of setting and length for PSAN so that the two changes can be separated.
prior_exposure: all round-2 to round-6 test results, including the frozen disease-only results and the post hoc step-matched disease-only results

controls.c2_30: gfnet_matched and lowrank16 in results/round6/disease/final (frozen round-6 protocol)
controls.c2_72: gfnet_matched and lowrank16 in results/round6_posthoc/disease/final (post hoc protocol)

unchanged: data (round-6 disease-only split and labels), sampler, augmentation, optimizer, EMA, gradient clipping, checkpoint rule and training loop of experiments.round6.train

statistics.ci: crossed group x seed bootstrap across seeds 42-44

concurrency: up to two jobs per GPU on four otherwise idle GPUs
